reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that repeatedly delivers user-defined prompts to the current agent at scheduled intervals, with controls for concurrent loops and an in-chat status display; automation is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于按固定间隔向当前智能体发送提示词，并在聊天界面中管理多个并发循环任务。
summaries.en: Schedules recurring prompts for the current agent and lets users manage multiple concurrent loops from the chat interface.

capabilities: Schedules recurring prompts for the current agent session
Starts, stops, lists, and reports the status of multiple concurrent loops
Displays active loop status in the chat interface
